# blip25c FEC subset

Only hard/soft 3600x2450 FEC and Golay tables, extracted from SPEAR's
apps/std_t98/blip25c at d1611fd408939ad238372d58828639e8fde28400.
FEC algorithms are unchanged; popcnt32 is the original portable helper.
No voice synthesis or mbelib compatibility layer is linked.
See LICENSE (MIT) and ../../PROVENANCE.md.
